Removed «aEton», «XS Usenet» and «Usenet.Today» (XS Usenet merged with EasyUsenet; Usenet.Today merged with XS News)
Frugal Usenet has regained its multi-backbone status as an XS News reseller.
Abavia added a new US-based server available to XS News and EasyUsenet.
Several Usenet providers (NewsFusion, SMSUseNET, Usenet Newsfeed, and Z51) were removed due to ceasing operations.
Provider retention levels were updated across all providers.
The company section has been revised to accurately represent ownership and use correct company names.
Removed «Frugal Usenet MB» from Usenet.Farm, removed «MB» from «Frugal Usenet» at NetNews.

g.text: It may not be 100% accurate, but we rely on the best available data and industry insights, please feel free to reach out to us.
A small, passionate team constantly maintains and updates this map, published by rexum and accessible at usenet.rexum.space/tree.
Typically, one or two providers suffice for excellent retention and redundancy. Refer to the accompanying table and map legend for further details.
This resource visually represents all major backbones and their associated resellers, showcasing retention levels.
The obscurity of Usenet providers' backbone relationships often results in users unknowingly purchasing multiple accounts on the same network.
